key.name: enable-customization
key.description: Adds an edit button to Quick Settings to add and remove toggles.

key.name: removed-toggles
key.summary: Built-in toggles removed from Quick Settings

key.name: added-toggles
key.summary: Extra toggles added to Quick Settings, in order

key.name: toggle-order
key.summary: Order of the Quick Settings controls
key.description: Ids of toggles, sliders ("slider:…") and the media player ("media") in the order set in the editor. Controls not listed keep their place.

key.name: small-toggles
key.description: Toggle ids shown as small tiles. Moved into control-sizes when the extension starts.

key.name: control-sizes
key.summary: Sizes of the Quick Settings controls
key.description: Each entry is "id:size". Toggles are large or small; sliders wide, half, tall or tower; the media player large, compact or square. Controls not listed have their default size.

key.name: hide-accessibility-menu
key.summary: Hide the top bar accessibility menu
key.description: The accessibility toggles are available in the Quick Settings editor instead.

key.name: pill-sliders
key.description: Thick sliders with the icon inside the filled part, as in the mockups.

key.name: dnd-menu
key.description: Give the Do Not Disturb toggle a menu to turn it on for an hour, until the evening or until tomorrow.

key.name: dnd-until
key.summary: When Do Not Disturb turns itself off
key.description: Unix time; 0 while it stays on until turned off.

key.name: android-tiles
key.description: Taller rounded tiles with the icon in a rounded square, small tiles that turn from round to square when on, and thicker sliders, as on Android 16.

key.name: app-volume
key.description: Adds a slider for each app playing sound to the menu of the volume slider.

key.name: panel-shortcuts
key.description: Middle-click the volume icon to mute, and scroll over the battery icon to change the screen brightness.

key.name: command-toggles
key.description: One JSON object per toggle: {"id", "name", "icon", "on", "off", "status"}. With "off" it switches on and off; with "status" (a command that exits with 0 while on) it shows the state.

key.name: toggle-subtitles
key.summary: Connection details under the toggle titles
key.description: The speed of a wired connection, the battery of the Bluetooth device and what is going on when nothing is connected, as on One UI.

key.name: live-activities
key.description: Timers, the stopwatch, screen recordings and the progress apps report show in an island in the top bar and at the top of Quick Settings.

key.name: island-notifications
key.summary: Notifications come out of the island
key.description: Notification banners grow out of the live activity island (or the clock) and go back into it, as on iOS.

key.name: island-osd
key.summary: Volume and brightness in the island
key.description: Volume and brightness changes show in the live activity island, as on iOS, instead of the shell's popup.

key.name: island-hover
key.description: Resting the pointer on the island opens its card; it closes when the pointer leaves.

key.name: lock-player
key.description: A large player with the cover under the lock screen clock, instead of the small one among the notifications.

key.name: clipboard-popup
key.description: A shortcut opens the clipboard history to paste from it, as Super+V does on Windows. History is kept while this or the clipboard widget is on.

key.name: clipboard-panel-button
key.summary: Clipboard history button in the top bar
key.description: A button in the top bar opens the clipboard history, as the shortcut does.

key.name: clipboard-shortcut
key.description: Takes Super+V from the shortcut that opens the notification list, which keeps Super+M.

key.name: emoji-shortcut
key.description: Opens the clipboard popup on its emoji tab, as Win+. does on Windows.

key.name: ibus-hotkeys-taken
key.summary: IBus emoji hotkeys taken for the emoji panel
key.description: Given back to IBus when the clipboard popup is turned off or the emoji shortcut changes.

key.name: timer-state
key.description: JSON state of the running timer and stopwatch, so they go on through a lock.

key.name: panel-clock
key.summary: Time and date in Quick Settings
key.description: The time, large, and the date at the start of the Quick Settings system row, as on One UI; its buttons gather at the end. On laptops the battery stays in the top bar only.

key.name: panel-weather
key.description: The weather icon and temperature next to the date in the top bar, for the calendar's first location.

key.name: panel-motion
key.description: Quick Settings springs open out of its button with the controls following in a wave, shrinks back when it closes, and sliders grow while dragged.

key.name: enable-collapsible
key.description: Shows notifications and the media player in Quick Settings. Only one of the two groups is expanded at a time.

key.name: enable-calendar
key.description: A calendar popover without notifications that scales with its content.

key.name: calendar-layout
key.description: "adaptive" adds the date and events column only when there are events; "two-columns" always shows it.

key.name: show-events
key.summary: Show today's events next to the calendar

key.name: enable-widgets
key.description: Replaces the world clocks and weather cards under the calendar with customizable widgets.

key.name: widgets
key.summary: Widgets under the calendar, in order
key.description: Each entry is "id:size", where size is small, medium or large.

key.name: reminders
key.summary: Reminders of the reminders widget, in order
key.description: One JSON object per reminder: {"id", "text", "due" (Unix time, optional), "notified"}.

key.name: stock-symbols
key.summary: Symbols shown by the stocks widget
key.description: Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. "AAPL", "PETR4.SA", "^BVSP", "BTC-USD". While unset, a default list for the language region is used.
